description: This file defines a React component 'ProjectDetailsModal' that displays project details such as ID, name, and last updated timestamp. It fetches project name asynchronously and renders a modal with key-value pairs. It also includes a helper component 'KeyValueList' for rendering the details in a styled grid.

methods.name: ProjectDetailsModal
methods.description: React functional component that displays project details in a modal, fetching project name asynchronously based on project ID.

methods.name: KeyValueList
methods.description: Helper component that renders a list of key-value pairs in a styled grid layout.
